`tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` now rounds half-up. I haven't run it or any tests.

The function was a `NotImplementedError` stub, so there was no existing rounding to change. I implemented it as `amount_cents × rate`, rounded to a whole cent with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, and it returns an `int`. The rate goes through `Decimal(str(rate))` to avoid float error. The result is `int(Decimal(amount_cents * rate).quantize(1, ROUND_HALF_UP))`, so 0.5 cents rounds up to 1.

The EngramDB memory "Tax uses ROUND_HALF_EVEN" (the March 2026 decision with finance) contradicted your instruction. I updated it in place to say half-up, as of 2026-10-01.

I assumed `rate` is a fraction like `0.0825` and the result is in cents. If callers pass percentages, the formula needs a `/ 100`.
